activeVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityDescription: A moderate-severity denial-of-service vulnerability (CVE-2026-13245) in a transitive JSON-parsing dependency used by the grants-api service.
activeVulnerabilities.potentialAgencyImpact: Low. Exploitation would require an authenticated session and would only affect the availability of a single non-critical reporting endpoint.

activeVulnerabilities.vulnerabilityDescription: Outdated OpenSSH server version on one legacy batch-processing host, missing several point releases behind current.
activeVulnerabilities.potentialAgencyImpact: Low. The host is not internet-reachable and access is restricted to a single automation service account with key-based authentication.

vulnerabilityDetail.vulnerabilityDescription: The internal-only PostgreSQL replication endpoint (port 5432, VPC-restricted) offers TLS 1.2 in addition to TLS 1.3.
vulnerabilityDetail.potentialAgencyImpact: Negligible. The endpoint is not internet-reachable and is restricted to VPC-internal replication traffic only.

acceptedVulnerabilities.acceptanceRationale: The endpoint is not internet-reachable and is restricted to VPC-internal replication traffic. Risk is accepted until the managed database service completes its planned engine upgrade in Q1 2027.
